summary: This software provides a Node.js-based implementation for running a peer-to-peer file sharing coordination point. It handles client communication and peer discovery within the BitTorrent network protocol. It serves as a lightweight utility for coordinating data transfers without participating in the storage or distribution of the actual files.
goodFor: Developers building custom peer-to-peer file distribution systems or those needing a simple JavaScript-driven tracking node for private networks.
watchOut: Maintenance has slowed down recently, which might mean slower responses to protocol updates or security issues. It also faces heavy competition from more mature tracker implementations written in compiled languages.
deployNotes: Because it runs on Node.js, you will typically need to manage a persistent process using a manager like PM2 or systemd. You should also place it behind a reverse proxy if you require TLS termination or port forwarding management.
